svg.title: A script, annotated
svg.desc: `param` + `///` become the `--dest` flag and its `--help` text · `secret`: never printed, never in argv, also read from `NALU_TOKEN` · `$( )` captures the output; `catch` recovers when it fails · `{x}` is always one argument, spaces and all · `defer` runs on exit, on failure and on Ctrl+C · `parallel` runs the tasks at once and collects every error · `os` is a compile-time constant: the other branch is not even generated
